name: HERA North Hall (H1)
notes: No official DESY page or the H1 detector paper was fetched with a coordinate specific to the North Hall in this session; the general DESY campus point is reused here with a note, per A17.
src:h1-wikipedia confirms: 'The HERA North Hall, where the H1 detector was located, is now used for the new ALPS experiment' — corroborating the North Hall/H1 pairing used in the ID registry.

summary.plain: The experimental hall on the HERA ring at DESY where the H1 detector recorded electron-proton collisions.
summary.technical: HERA North Hall, DESY campus, housing the H1 detector (1992-2007); now used for the ALPS experiment. No coordinate distinct from the general DESY campus point was found in this session (see note).
